body:
This proposal sets inflation from the treasuryReward module to zero, resulting in treasury inflation of ~5% or $1.5m/year (from staking inefficiencies).

For discussion, see: [https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/886-proposal-calibrating-the-edgeware-treasury-budget](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/886-proposal-calibrating-the-edgeware-treasury-budget)
